answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the mirror graph. Re-attestations are stored in kernel and lantern lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1431 impostors cost 1637 times the honest price and take 4 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
